title: (RHEA-2008:0766) evolution enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated evolution packages that address a change in the way the Network
Security Services (NSS) libraries are delivered are now available.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
Evolution is the GNOME mailer, calendar, contact manager and communications
tool. The components which make up Evolution are tightly integrated with
one another and act as a seamless personal information-management tool.

The NSS libraries included with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 4.7 are now a
stand-alone package (previously they were included as part of the seamonkey
RPM). The NSS libraries are development libraries which support
cross-platform development of security-enabled client and server
applications. Applications built with NSS, such as Evolution, can support
SSLv2 and SSLv3, TLS, PKCS #5, PKCS #7, PKCS #11, PKCS #12, S/MIME, X.509
v3 certificates, and other security standards.

The updated version of Evolution included in this package have been
re-built against the stand-alone nss package.

All Evolution users should upgrade to this updated package, which caters to
this change.
